salary_baseline: 2025 national median; gov figures reflect OPM 2025 base pay + Rest of US locality (17.06%)

levels.title: Cybersecurity Analyst I
skills: Python scripting for alert parsing and automation
levels.next_steps: Move from alert triage to alert investigation — write detection rules, document runbooks, and begin studying threat hunting fundamentals.
levels.milestone: Handle a full incident triage cycle solo: identify, contain, eradicate, and write the post-incident report without hand-holding.

levels.title: Cybersecurity Analyst II / Junior Security Engineer
skills: Malware analysis basics (static and dynamic, sandbox detonation)
Threat intel feeds and standards (MISP, STIX/TAXII)
MITRE ATT&CK framework navigation and mapping
Scripting in Python and Bash for automation
levels.next_steps: Build a full pentest lab (Metasploitable, DVWA, HackTheBox) and complete at least one end-to-end engagement report. Start OSCP prep.
levels.milestone: Conduct an independent vulnerability assessment on a scoped lab environment and deliver a professional written report with CVSS-scored findings.

levels.title: Cybersecurity Engineer / Penetration Tester
skills: Full penetration testing lifecycle (web app, network, cloud)
Red team TTPs mapped to MITRE ATT&CK
Active Directory attack and defense (Kerberoasting, Pass-the-Hash, BloodHound)
Security tool development in Python or Go
Purple team exercise planning and execution
levels.next_steps: Own a full red team engagement from scoping through debrief. Build a custom C2 implant or detection rule set and present findings to a blue team.
levels.milestone: Lead a full-scope internal red team operation, produce an executive summary and technical findings report, and run the purple team debrief.

levels.title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer / Security Architect
skills: Security architecture design and review (zero-trust, defense-in-depth)
Purple team program design and leadership
Threat intelligence program leadership (collection, analysis, dissemination)
Technical writing for executive and board audiences
levels.next_steps: Lead a team of mid-level engineers and own the security roadmap for a product line or business unit. Develop expertise in reverse engineering or advanced exploitation and pursue GXPN. Begin scoping an internal red team program.
levels.milestone: Design and defend a full enterprise security architecture — including zero-trust segmentation, detection strategy, and incident response plan — to a skeptical leadership audience.

levels.title: Staff / Principal Cybersecurity Engineer
skills: Enterprise security program design (people, process, technology)
National and organizational cyber policy input
Red team program leadership and roadmap ownership
Cross-functional collaboration with legal, HR, and engineering leadership
Large-scale threat modeling across complex distributed systems
levels.next_steps: Publish original security research, speak at a major conference (DEF CON, Black Hat), and establish an org-wide red team or vulnerability research function.
levels.milestone: Discover and responsibly disclose a novel vulnerability class or author a security framework adopted org-wide or industry-wide.

levels.title: CISO / Distinguished Security Researcher
skills: Board-level risk communication and cyber risk quantification
National cyber policy development and advocacy
M&A security due diligence and integration
Threat intelligence strategy and program ownership
Security culture transformation across large organizations
Regulatory compliance oversight (CMMC, FISMA, FedRAMP, SOC 2, PCI-DSS)
Crisis communications and breach response leadership
Talent strategy, hiring, and team building at scale
levels.next_steps: Own the organization's full security posture and risk program. Shape industry standards. Sit on advisory boards or serve as a board director for security matters.
levels.milestone: Lead the organization through a major breach or regulatory audit with zero material harm — owning the response, communications, and remediation program end-to-end.
